command:
set -eu
printf '== identity ==\n'
id
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '== os ==\n'
cat /etc/os-release
uname -a
printf '== init and package tools ==\n'
printf 'pid1='; ps -p 1 -o comm=
command -v rpm || true
command -v dnf || true
command -v yum || true
printf '== cron software ==\n'
command -v crontab || true
rpm -q cronie cronie-anacron 2>/dev/null || true
crontab --version 2>&1 || true
printf '== users ==\n'
getent passwd root opsadmin || true
id root
id opsadmin || true
printf '== cron access files ==\n'
for f in /etc/cron.allow /etc/cron.deny; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then ls -lZ "$f"; stat -c '%n mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s mtime=%y' "$f"; sha256sum "$f"; sed -n '1,200p' "$f"; else printf '%s absent\n' "$f"; fi
done
printf '== service state ==\n'
systemctl is-enabled crond 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-active crond 2>&1 || true
systemctl --no-pager --full status crond 2>&1 | sed -n '1,30p'
printf '== recent failures ==\n'
systemctl --failed --no-pager 2>&1 || true
journalctl -u crond -n 30 --no-pager 2>&1 || true
printf '== cron protected data inventory ==\n'
if [ -d /var/spool/cron ]; then stat -c '%n mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /var/spool/cron; find /var/spool/cron -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %m %u %g %s\n' | sort; find /var/spool/cron -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort; fi
printf '== security ==\n'
getenforce 2>/dev/null || true
mount | sed -n '/ on \/ /p'
printf '== listeners ==\n'
ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || true
